applyFailed: The rules could not be applied.
closesByItself: Ports of a server that is switched off, removed or moved to another port close by themselves within a minute. Opening a port always needs this button.
diff.hook.dedupe: ~ keep exactly one jump to GSS-ALLOW, first in DOCKER-USER
diff.hook.insert: + jump to GSS-ALLOW as the first rule of DOCKER-USER
diff.hook.move: ~ move the jump to GSS-ALLOW back to the top of DOCKER-USER
family.absent: {{name}}: no DOCKER-USER chain (Docker's {{name}} firewall is off) — left alone.
intro: Opens the published game ports of the enabled servers in Docker's DOCKER-USER chain, through a chain of its own (GSS-ALLOW). It only ever adds ACCEPT rules there: it never blocks anything and never changes other rules, SSH included.
noPorts: No enabled server publishes a port that can be reached from outside.
off: Off. To switch it on, set GSS_FIREWALL_TOKEN (for example with `openssl rand -hex 32`) and add firewall to COMPOSE_PROFILES in the .env, then run `docker compose up -d`. The table shows what it would open.
